01 / 08CHAPMAN

Parking Master Planning

Bring parking and mobility into the broader real estate planning conversation. A master plan considers how parking supports the property today and how those needs may evolve as the development changes.

  • The relationship between parking supply, land use, access and future development phases.
  • Opportunities to coordinate parking across buildings, uses and different times of day.
